typography.instructions: BANNED FONTS: Inter, Roboto, Open Sans. Use 'Outfit' for all headings (H1-H6) with tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) to give a premium SaaS feel. Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for all body text, inputs, and tabular data to ensure crisp readability. Do not exceed text-5xl for main greetings on mobile. Maintain a maximum 2-step Tailwind jump between heading and subheading.

colors.palette_strategy: Archetype 3 (Pastel & Soft) fused with premium SaaS aesthetics. Highly readable, optimistic, and action-oriented.
colors.instructions: Never use pure black (#000000); always use the tinted charcoal (#0F172A). Use QwickAds purple/lavender for the primary identity. Success/Conversion MUST be Green, Follow-ups MUST be Orange/Yellow, Negative Outcomes MUST be Red. Use semantic colors heavily for the call outcome buttons.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft, premium shadows (shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]) for dashboard cards. Avoid harsh, dark shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use subtle borders (border-purple-100 or border-slate-200) to define edges. Card radius should be rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl on mobile for a 'zoom-in' app feel, and rounded-xl on desktop.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 with 1px white top border) for the mobile bottom nav and sticky action bars. Solid white for cards on the #FDFBFF background.

grids_and_layouts.mobile_strategy: Mobile-first. Use a 'Zoom In' approach with large, touch-friendly cards. Vertical scrolling with sticky bottom navigation. Call/WhatsApp buttons must be massive and sticky.
grids_and_layouts.desktop_strategy: Admin Dashboard must use high-density bento grids for analytics. Left collapsible sidebar for navigation. Utilize pure HTML/Tailwind for complex layout matrices rather than forcing Shadcn wrappers where inappropriate.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Add breathing room between sections.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or highly rounded (rounded-xl) for standard buttons. Action buttons must have hover lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow increase.
components.cards: Cardless or soft-rounded styles. Employee dashboard greeting should feel expansive, not boxed in. Today's Calls should be stacked cards.
components.inputs_and_forms: Use Shadcn UI for forms, heavily styled to remove the default Vercel look. Inputs should have subtle purple focus rings (focus:ring-primary/50).
components.modals: Use Shadcn Dialogs. Must be bottom-sheet style on mobile, centered modal on desktop. Conversion modal MUST include a confetti overlay.
components.data_tables: Admin employee performance table must use clean, padding-rich rows (Shadcn Table) with badge indicators for statuses.

motion.micro_interactions: Card hover lifts, button presses (scale: 0.98), smooth state changes.
motion.data_animations: Animated number counters for dashboard stats (Calls Today, Interested). Animated progress bar for Daily Targets.
motion.notifications: Use 'sonner' for toast notifications. Smooth enter/exit.
motion.instructions: Motion should feel swift and highly responsive. Do not use 'transition: all'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on primary purple buttons is pure white. Use APCA-compliant contrast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based format (e.g., data-testid='call-outcome-interested').
accessibility.focus: Maintain clear focus states for keyboard navigation, especially for the Admin desktop view.

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all icons. Icons should be beautifully sized (w-5 h-5 or w-6 h-6) and use semantic colors where appropriate.
media.charts: Use Shadcn charts (Recharts) for Admin Analytics (sales funnel, loss-reason charts).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts 'Outfit' and 'Plus Jakarta Sans'. Setup Tailwind properly with the provided variables.
Implement a role-based structure: Mobile layout for 'Sales Employee' (bottom nav) and Desktop layout for 'Admin' (sidebar).
The Employee Dashboard must have a massive 'Today's Calls' section with native 'tel:' links and WhatsApp deep links.
Use framer-motion for the daily target progress bar and dashboard counters.
Call outcome workflow MUST be colored buttons (Green/Orange/Red) with smooth modal popups for follow-up scheduling.
Admin dashboard requires sales funnel charts and 'Why did they say no' visualization using recharts.
Include 'react-confetti' triggering upon marking a lead as 'Converted'.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
